purpose: Teach: フルタイム/所以/独禁法/両氏/所収/インタラクティブ/送受信/キャッチフレーズ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、フルタイム雇用前に経験を積め
lines.en: Ren, build your experience before moving into full-time employment.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Leans forward slightly. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. No impatience, but no room for shortcuts. The tone of someone who has seen enough to know what matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室が評価される所以を見つめ直します
lines.en: Yes. I'll reassess what makes our lab worthy of recognition.
lines.style: Thoughtful intake of breath. Sincere, not performative. Speaks slowly, as if turning the words over. Respectful but not deferential — this is his commitment, not a bow.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究契約も独禁法を意識しろ
lines.en: Ren, stay mindful of antitrust law when you're reviewing research contracts.
lines.style: Steady, factual tone. A brief pause before the key term — 「独禁法」 — to let it land. Not lecturing, but ensuring he understands the weight. Practical, not punitive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先輩研究員両氏に相談しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm already consulting with both senior researchers on this.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Speaks a beat faster, showing he's already ahead of the guidance. No eagerness to please — just a statement of fact. Clear and direct.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文所収の学会誌を網羅しろ
lines.en: Ren, cover the full range of journals where your paper might be published.
lines.style: Crisp opening. Each word precisely placed. The instruction itself is the emphasis — no need to soften it. A slight forward lean, eyes steady. The tone of a mentor who trusts you to hear this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。インタラクティブな実験装置を取り入れます
lines.en: Yes. I'll incorporate interactive experimental equipment into the methodology.
lines.style: Measured response with a hint of thoughtful pause. Shows he's considering how to integrate this suggestion, not just accepting it. Respectful cadence, internally processing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究データの送受信プロトコルを守れ
lines.en: Ren, follow the data transmission protocols we've established.
lines.style: Final instruction, landed with finality but not harshness. Clear and non-negotiable. A slight drop at the end — this is the last point, and it matters. The tone of someone closing a conversation, not dismissing it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の魅力的なキャッチフレーズを考えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll draft a compelling title and framing for the paper.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. A slight exhale, as if gathering all the points into action. The final affirmation — not rushed, but complete. Respectful fade at the end, showing the conversation has landed.
